source_text: þennan. I. add :-- Þyder [h]is þened qua tenditur, An. Ox. 17, 53. I a. figurative, to extend the fame of, exalt :-- Þenaþ, tóbǽd prosequitur, i. tractat t laudat (integritatem immensis rumorum laudibus prosequitur, Ald. 26, 8), An. Ox. 1919. v. on-þennan.
